Azure costs for pool-47-205, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 (cache, refreshed 2026-10-02):

- Virtual Machines $6,218: NCasT4_v3 Series $4,312, Dv5 Series $1,906
- Storage $1,229: Standard HDD Managed Disks $688, Premium SSD Managed Disks $541
- Bandwidth $214 (Inter Region)
- Subscription total $7,661; gpu_cost field $5,000

The GPU figure to charge the ML team is $4,312. That is the NCasT4_v3 Series meter, the only GPU VM series on the subscription (NC-series are the T4 GPU VMs; Dv5 is general purpose).

Do not use the $5,000 gpu_cost field. It overstates GPU spend by $688, and the $688 is exactly the Standard HDD Managed Disks storage meter. The gpu_cost figure is built by a substring match for "NC", "ND" or "NV" in the upper-cased meter subcategory. "STANDARD HDD MANAGED DISKS" contains "ND" (from "staNDard"), so the disk charge gets counted as GPU. $4,312 + $688 = $5,000.
